source.work: pstack principles (boundary, domain, reader load, idempotency, legacy deletion, proof)
source.paraphrase: Hidden mutable state is a fact the reader has to keep in their head. Shrink that scope to the operation that actually changes the value.

invariants.why: A module-level let is hidden state. A reader of one function cannot know who else writes it.
invariants.fixHint: Move the binding inside the function that uses it, or make it const if it never changes.
invariants.avoid: `const` at module scope is not this rule. `var` belongs to the senior pack. A `let` inside a function, including a for loop initializer, is local and allowed. Renaming the binding does not move it.

relations.why: A bare @deprecated JSDoc tag is reported by both rules, and the written notice MAINT-DEPR-001 asks for is still a comment PS-COMMENT-001 reports.
relations.settle: Migrating the callers and deleting the deprecated API satisfies both. Teams that keep deprecated surfaces exclude the files that carry them from PS-COMMENT-001.

source.work: pstack principles (boundary, domain, reader load, idempotency, legacy deletion, proof)
source.paraphrase: Comments that restate the next line add a second text the reader must keep in sync. The workflow that deletes them is a process; this rule is the comment shapes that process can refuse.

invariants.why: A narration comment goes stale and splits the reader's attention. The code should carry the fact. An owned TODO is a tracked debt, not narration.
invariants.fixHint: Delete the comment if it restates the code. If it records a reason, say the reason in the comment. If the debt is real, write TODO(owner) with an owner of at least two characters, matching the vibe-proof TODO rule.
invariants.avoid: The pattern cannot compare a comment with the code after it, so this rule reports every comment that is not one of the exempt shapes, and the default severity is warn. Allowlisted: TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX(owner), @ts-expect-error, eslint-, biome-ignore, pregate-, istanbul, c8, SPDX-License-Identifier, Copyright, @license, and /// <reference. Also exempt, unless the comment carries @deprecated: a JSDoc block, a comment with an http or https URL, a comment that names a license, and a comment with one of the reason words because, since, so, otherwise, instead of, rather than, in order to, to avoid, to prevent, to ensure, due to, workaround or why. @ts-ignore and @ts-nocheck are not allowlisted. A fake owner or an added reason word satisfies the spelling; that is a social hole, not a structural one.

source.work: pstack principles (boundary, domain, reader load, idempotency, legacy deletion, proof)
source.paraphrase: Remove the dead statement before adding the new one. A comment that keeps the old statement around is the dead code, still in the file.

invariants.why: Commented-out code is a second implementation. Readers do not know whether it is the old behavior, a sample, or the one that should run.
invariants.fixHint: Delete the comment. History already keeps the old statement.
invariants.avoid: A TODO(owner) or FIXME(owner) that mentions return is not this shape, because the comment does not start with the keyword. A comment that starts with a keyword and also carries an owner is exempt so it does not fight the owned-TODO allowlist.
